functions.purpose: ARM C-library scatterload: PIC-relocate (dst,src,size,handler) records from 0x100073A0..0x100073D0 and tail-call each handler; empty table falls through to InvokeMainAfterRuntimeInit.

immediates.meaning: PIC offset from literal pool to scatterload table start 0x100073A0
PIC offset to scatterload table end 0x100073D0

functions.purpose: push {r0-r4,lr}/pop {r0-r4,pc} trampoline used as __user_setup_stackheap: returns the incoming r0/r1 pair as a 64-bit value.
Empty atexit/fini hook (push {r4,lr}; pop {r4,pc}). Called from CallFiniThenSemihostExit.

ARM __rt_entry: InitializeRuntimeStackHeap, stackheap trampoline, RunRideControlLoop (main), HandleRuntimeMainExit. Ghidra still overlays the following oscillator-watchdog body via an unrecovered tail; that body lives at EnableOscWatchdogAndScu0Irq.
C-library exit: ReturnEmptyFiniStub then HandleSemihostingSysExit (BKPT 0xAB, r0=SYS_EXIT 0x18). Oscillator-watchdog code originally merged here was split to 0x100010d0.
Enable SCU_CLK.OSCCSR oscillator watchdog (OWDEN|OWDRES), wait, fail if OSC2L/OSC2H; clear SCU SR LOCI|SBYCLKFI; cpsie i; NVIC_EnableIRQ(SCU_0).

immediates.meaning: Settle delay after watchdog enable before sampling OSC2L/OSC2H

functions.purpose: RTC/SCU periodic-IRQ helper: increment DCO sample counter at calibState+8 unless it is already -1.
Store DCO target count and percent (clamped 1..100), compute windowDelta=(target*percent)/100, set [low,high]=target±delta if both fit in 0x7FFFFFFF.

immediates.meaning: Max signed-32 bound for target and windowDelta

functions.purpose: CLKCR CNTADJ=0x3FF, SCU PASSWD unlock 0xC0, ungate RTC (CGATCLR0 bit 10), wait VDDC2HIGH clear, lock 0xC3, enable RTC.CTR.ENB, mask RTC periodic seconds, NVIC_EnableIRQ(SCU_1).

immediates.meaning: Timeout waiting CLKCR.VDDC2HIGH then RTC_CTR mirror

functions.purpose: Program DCO window, enable RTC clock, mark calib state=2, SysTick_Config(LOAD=0xBB50, VAL=0, CTRL=7) with NVIC_SetPriority(SysTick_IRQn, 3); return 2 if SysTick already running.

immediates.meaning: Calibration FSM state byte at calibState-4

functions.purpose: On first call force in-window; later ticksPerPeriod=sampleCount/periodCount must lie in (windowLow, windowHigh). Reset counters; publish measureValid.

immediates.meaning: First-run flag at 0x20002744; skip window check once

functions.purpose: RTC period tick: set status byte 2, increment periodCount, EvaluateOscMeasureInWindow, store result at calibState-4.
Assert/fault sink: if statusFlag==0 spin forever. Called from SCU ISR on FLECC2I (flash ECC).
Increment software-timer index; every 100000 ticks fire optional callback; reset event-flag words to {~0, 0, ~0, 0}.
Set running-mask bit; if already set, or into pending and notify callback at eventFlagBase-0x18.
Clear idle-mask bit; if it was already clear, or into pending and notify the same change callback.
If tickDelta in 1..0x400000, add it to elapsed counter at eventFlagBase-4.
If tickDelta in 1..0x400000, subtract it from remaining counter at eventFlagBase-8.
If periodCallback non-null, SysTick_Config(LOAD=0xBB50) at priorities 3 then 1, wait ENABLE, scale interval 5500 by actual/expected reload.

immediates.meaning: Software-timer period in ticks before reload scaling

functions.purpose: SysTick software-timer: increment tickCount; when tickCount % period == 0, callback(elapsed == ~remain) and reset counters.
CMSIS NVIC_SetPriority copy: 2-bit priority in bits 7:6 of IPR (0xE000E400) or SCB SHPR (0xE000ED00+0x1C) for negative IRQn. Distinct from the duplicate at 0x10001954.

immediates.meaning: Priority byte mask before shift into IPR/SHPR word
